name: Funnel Accounts
description: Accounts that collect deposits from many locations, often in different geographic areas, and funnel the money onward, frequently to another jurisdiction, so as to avoid direct links with the criminal source. They are commonly used in drug trafficking and fraud cash networks.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering through the Physical Transportation of Cash (2015)
FFIEC, BSA/AML Examination Manual (FinCEN is not publisher)

indicators.name: Cash deposits from many states or regions
indicators.canon: Cash deposits from many states or regions
indicators.desc: Account receives cash deposits across geographically distant locations from the account holder's home area.
indicators.ctx: Account receives cash deposits across geographically distant locations from the account holder's home area.

indicators.name: Rapid withdrawals following deposits in different location
indicators.canon: Rapid onward movement after cash credits
indicators.desc: Cash deposited is quickly withdrawn or transferred onward, including to another location or to unhosted wallets.
indicators.ctx: Funds credited in one area are withdrawn quickly elsewhere, often by ATM.

indicators.name: Account with little other activity
indicators.desc: No salary, bills, or everyday spending, only deposits and withdrawals.
indicators.ctx: No salary, bills, or everyday spending, only deposits and withdrawals.
indicators.fp: New or secondary accounts have limited use.

indicators.name: Individual or business holder lacks economic link to deposit areas
indicators.canon: Individual or business holder lacks economic link to deposit areas
indicators.desc: Account holder profile shows no business or family ties in places where deposits occur.
indicators.ctx: Account holder profile shows no business or family ties in places where deposits occur.
indicators.fp: Customers may be mobile or have remote clients.

indicators.name: Multiple unrelated depositors to same account
indicators.canon: Many unrelated depositors paying into one account
indicators.desc: Numerous unconnected individuals make deposits into the same account, often in similar amounts or within short windows.
indicators.ctx: Numerous third parties deposit into one account, sometimes with slips or reference.

indicators.name: Funds sent offshore soon after collection
indicators.canon: Funds sent offshore soon after collection
indicators.desc: Aggregated funds are wired or sent through remittance to foreign jurisdictions.
indicators.ctx: Aggregated funds are wired or sent through remittance to foreign jurisdictions.
indicators.fp: International students and migrants send funds abroad.

indicators.name: Account opened with limited documentation or by recruited individuals
indicators.canon: Account opened with limited documentation or by recruited individuals
indicators.desc: Account holders include students, unemployed people or newcomers sharing similar addresses.
indicators.ctx: Account holders include students, unemployed people or newcomers sharing similar addresses.

indicators.name: Use of cash deposit machines and cards across multiple accounts
indicators.canon: Use of cash deposit machines and cards across multiple accounts
indicators.desc: Debit cards or deposit tokens shared or sent to others to deposit.
indicators.ctx: Debit cards or deposit tokens shared or sent to others to deposit.
